rationale: v1.80.1 already contains public setConfig warm-cache restoration, vacuum map routing and New-device acknowledgement. This fixes accepted-write/cache ownership and rollback of those existing paths rather than polishing a newly introduced feature.

summary.ru: Сохранённый план не откатывается к старому кэшу, а отказ сохранения возвращает маршруты и отметку нового устройства.
summary.en: Saved plans no longer fall back to old cache, and refused saves restore routes and new-device attention.
